summary: Manager-level Balance Sheet Market Risk candidate with ~7 years across ALM, IRRBB, and model governance. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement) and operates IRRBB analytics under parallel and non-parallel shocks aligned with OSFI B-12 and Basel. Built a multi-scenario cash-flow projection engine and Python-based reconciliation pipelines. CFA + dual MSc; OSFI E-23 / SR 11-7 aware.

sections.heading: IRRBB, ALM & Balance-Sheet Risk
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), including independent review of curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Oversee interest rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.

Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios - delivering forward-looking liquidity and NII visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding, refinancing, and asset-allocation decisions under OSFI LAR-style requirements.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory expectations - serving as a primary contact for cross-business assumption setting.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Validation & Reconciliation
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework: independent review and challenge, assumption validation, and documentation standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; reconcile sensitivities (including KRD-style decomposition) and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates against first-line numbers.
Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation checks, and exception reporting - the template now reused on adjacent workflows.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validated outputs post-deployment.

Contributed to successful migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform; translated investment-team requirements into Product Owner development requests.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and PM functions on standards adoption; contributed governance documentation and regulatory-readiness materials.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors - analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base and stressed environments.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk; conducted LDI analysis for pension-fund clients.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis using Ortec's GLASS platform.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (jointly-sponsored plan), evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies; presented findings to investment committees on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
